description: Extract the fields below from one audit evidence. Copy values as written; never infer a date that is not printed. Return null for a field the document does not contain. Never state whether a control is covered: you only read the document.

evidenceType.instruction: Nature of the document. Pick one value of the closed list, never invent one. One of: POLICY, PROCEDURE, MINUTES, REPORT, EXPORT, SCREENSHOT, LIST, ATTESTATION.

title.instruction: Title as printed on the document.

documentDate.instruction: Date printed on the document, ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Null when absent.

periodStart.instruction: First day covered by the document, for a report or an export. Null otherwise.

periodEnd.instruction: Last day covered by the document, for a report or an export. Null otherwise.

author.instruction: Author or owner named on the document.

approver.instruction: Signatory or approver. Null when unsigned.

approvalDate.instruction: Date of approval or signature, ISO-8601. Null when unsigned.

client.instruction: Customer the evidence is about. Null when the evidence is internal.

summary.instruction: At most 3 sentences, factual, no judgement about any control.

personalData.instruction: True when the document names people (staff, customers) or carries personal data.
